Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a chemical enterprise located in the Boxing Economic Development Zone of Binzhou, Shandong Province, China. Situated in one of Shandong’s important industrial regions, the company benefits from convenient transportation, a strong manufacturing foundation, and access to a well-developed chemical industry supply chain. As its name suggests, the company focuses on the research, development, production, and application of cyclodextrin-related products, serving customers in industries that require advanced chemical materials and functional additives.

Cyclodextrins are widely used in fields such as pharmaceuticals, food, cosmetics, agriculture, daily chemicals, and environmental protection because of their unique molecular structure and inclusion-complex capabilities. By utilizing cyclodextrin technology, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is positioned to provide products and solutions that help improve solubility, stability, controlled release, odor masking, and bioavailability in various formulations. The company’s business direction reflects the growing demand for specialty chemicals with high added value and broad application potential.

Located in Boxing Economic Development Zone, the company operates in an environment that supports industrial innovation, production efficiency, and cooperation with upstream and downstream partners. Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is committed to quality-oriented development, technical improvement, and customer-focused service. With an emphasis on reliable production, product consistency, and application support, the company aims to meet the diverse needs of domestic and international clients. As the cyclodextrin market continues to expand, the company is well placed to contribute to the development of functional chemical materials and to provide dependable cyclodextrin-based products for a wide range of industrial applications.
